notes.title: Today we’d like to share some artworks with you
notes.content:
[p]Here are some characters from Dunar Dimension Two.
[/p][p]Some characters are key to the story, while others join you in the heat of battle — each one adding their own touch to the world of [i]Dunar Dimension Two[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43747517/5b949bcd93f3063b710037f59333f60be43a24e0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This is one of the guardians who protect the Five Elements.[/p][p]His name is Ravolt — better be prepared, because no one is going to steal his Element.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43747517/d64d55fc55a62a77c74c32f6adf09f182951e1d9.png"][/img][/p]
